criteria.evidence: Opens with "no capability gap" since failures and latency are already captured, then lists questions (per-run correlation, timeline, aggregation, alerting) to test for real gaps.
Recommends not adding a framework yet; first step is to extend existing logs with run ID, tool name, and structured JSON; escalates incrementally only if needed.
States a large framework adds a dependency, possibly a service to run, network egress, and risk of sending prompts/tool data to third parties; advises checking off-machine data and redacting.
